characters.name: 绾线
characters.accent: olive green and a tiny coral knot
characters.silhouette: soft folded-page spool seed with one low inward fold, a loose thread loop around one side and a short thread tail behind; no ears
characters.prop: one loose chest knot and a single thread end
actions: hides the knot behind the body while leaving one thread end visible
offers the thread and walks two steps forward, then looks back

characters.name: 听雨
characters.accent: sage green, muted rose and moon-cream
characters.silhouette: rounded folded-page rain vessel, slightly wider above, with one broad downward-curving leaf eave and a shallow water-color patch on the belly; no hat or ears
actions: listens to one drop on the leaf eave
catches one drop in the leaf dish
pours the drop into a tiny puddle where one flower opens

characters.name: 息摆
characters.accent: pale apricot paper tabs and one coral pendulum bead
characters.silhouette: compact body made from several rounded paper tabs leaning together, one short soft wind vane on top, three small tabs hanging on one side; no antenna or ears
actions: paper tabs sway at different rhythms
cups the pendulum bead so the tabs gradually synchronize
takes one slow breath and the tabs stop in sequence before opening the way

characters.name: 藏烬
characters.accent: cocoa brown, warm orange and a little gold
characters.silhouette: low stable rounded ember-seed shell, wider at the base, with one soft curved opening at the top and one small translucent chest window; no horns
characters.prop: one contained ember inside the chest window
actions: covers the chest window with both hands
opens one narrow vent so the ember becomes steady
turns the chest window toward the doorway and makes a warm path of light

characters.name: 铃芽
characters.accent: berry pink, cream white and a little apricot
characters.silhouette: rounded bell-flower seed body with one curved sprout on top and one tiny hanging bell flower on the side; no ear or wing reading
characters.prop: one small bell flower and one luminous seed
actions: the flower opens slowly and rings once
places one luminous seed in the ground and quietly invites the traveler forward
